Delhi government explores solar-powered EV charging stations

The Delhi government is exploring the installation of solar-powered electric vehicle charging stations. This initiative is part of the city's broader electric vehicle policy. The move aims to promote sustainable transportation and reduce reliance on conventional energy sources for charging EVs.
